summary: Cosan S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting 2Q26 results, highlighting simplification and capital structure optimization. Actions include a secondary IPO of Compass on B3 raising R$3.0 billion (net R$2.3 billion), sale of part of Radar portfolio (R$1.85 billion total, R$586 million for Cosan's stake; closing expected October 2026), and a letter of intent for the sale of Porto São Luís for R$300 million plus earn-out. These are asset sales and capital-raising moves, not a single transformative special situation. The filing also notes the start of delisting ADSs from the NYSE. What to watch: completion of Radar and Porto transactions and continued deleveraging.
